digest.component_or_area: plan-review pass-1 criterion registration and container handling
propositions: New 1-TURN criterion ac-satisfiability (facet coherence, advisory 0.95) must detect whether a ticket's own acceptance criteria and Scope/Out-of-Scope declarations are jointly satisfiable, catching three contradiction shapes: universal-vs-carve-out, derived-artifact closure, and snapshot cardinality

Sibling roster used by G3 child-coverage audit must carry each child's acceptance-criteria items extracted via evaluate_plan_clarity, not only ids and titles, to enable G3 to discharge its coverage check

Roster-building expression duplicated across pass1.py:154, fidelity_spot_eval.py:219, and eval_solver.py:117 must be single-sourced via shared build_sibling_roster helper to maintain consistency across production and eval harnesses

Roster must be moved from per-pairing instructions into byte-stable system-prompt prefix and counted in parent_tokens estimate to avoid re-sending it per pairing and to correctly budget for container bin-packing
Pass-2 verifier already owns internal_conflict axis, so this work adds no verifier or impact-model changes, only Pass-1 finding via new criterion
